featured_reviews.name: Pratima Khamkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased a pair of sandals from your store. The very next day after purchase, the heel screw came out.

I visited your store with the same sandals, and your staff repaired them and returned them to me.

However, within just 1 month, the exact same issue occurred again. When I went back, I was told that I would have to leave the sandals at the store and they would repair and return them.

After 10 days, I visited again. Your manager, Mr. Husaifa, thanked me and offered a replacement, asking me to choose a new pair. Impressed by this gesture, I even purchased one additional pair from your store.

But just 2 days after the replacement, the heel of the new sandals completely came off while I was walking. I am a doctor at a hospital, and this incident was extremely embarrassing for me in a public setting.

I called R City Mall regarding this, after which I received a call from the Metro Showroom. Your employee, Mr. Sadik, casually told me, “Ma’am, this heel does not suit you, no problem, show it whenever you come.” The response was highly casual and showed no concern or empathy for the embarrassing situation I faced.

This is pathetic service from a brand. After multiple repairs, a replacement, and still facing the same defect, I have completely lost trust in your product quality and after-sales support.

*I expect the following resolution immediately:*
1. Full refund for both pairs of defective sandals
2. Written assurance on quality checks for your products
3. Action against the dismissive attitude of staff towards genuine customer issues

Please treat this as urgent. I will be waiting for your resolution. If not addressed, I will have to escalate this to consumer forums and social media.

Thanks

featured_reviews.name: NĪSHANT JADHAV
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Bata Shoe Store in Ghatkopar, and overall, it was a decent experience. The store is well-organized, with a good display of footwear ranging from formal shoes to casual wear, sandals, and sneakers. Bata, being a long-established brand, is known for comfort and durability, and this store lives up to that reputation with a wide variety of options for different age groups.
The staff is generally helpful and assists in finding sizes and suggesting options, although the level of attentiveness can vary depending on how crowded the store is. The trial process is smooth, and billing is fairly quick, which is always appreciated when you’re just trying to buy shoes and leave.
However, pricing can feel slightly on the higher side compared to online platforms, where the same products are often available at discounted rates. During peak hours, the store can get crowded, leading to delays in service and less personalized attention.
Overall, Bata Shoe Store is a reliable place for comfortable and quality footwear. With better pricing consistency and improved service during busy times, the experience could be much more satisfying.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Urgent Complaint: Defective Product and Unacceptable Service Quality
Dear Inc5 shoes company ,
I am writing to register my extreme dissatisfaction regarding a recent purchase and the subsequent poor service I received.
The shoes I purchased [ 'The athletic shoes'] became defective after only two days of use, highlighting a serious failure in product quality.
Upon bringing this issue to your attention, the customer service I received was highly unsatisfactory:
• Refusal to Exchange: The request for a replacement or exchange was denied.
• Subpar Repair Service: Instead of resolving the issue, a pasting service was offered. This repair was poorly executed and damaged the shoes further.
• Excessive Delay: Compounding the problem, the process of receiving the shoes back after the repair took an unacceptable delay of 20 days.
The combination of flawed merchandise and this inadequate, delaying, and damaging service is completely unacceptable.
I demand an immediate and suitable resolution, which should include a full refund or a brand-new replacement of the product.
Sincerely,
